children: Here’s an interesting stock idea: The stock idea that we have for you today is Nuvama Wealth Management. The stock has been stuck in a sideways range for more than a month now. Within that the price is going up towards the upper end of the range. The bias is positive. We expect stock to make a bullish breakout of this range and go higher in the coming weeks.
